What is the 10 EMA ↑ 50 EMA stock screener?
10-day EMA crossed above the 50-day EMA in the last 5 trading days (event detection). It scans USA stocks and currently lists 544 matching companies, refreshed every trading day.
How often is the 10 EMA ↑ 50 EMA screen updated?
The screen is recalculated every trading day after market close using the latest price, volume and fundamental data.
How many USA stocks match the 10 EMA ↑ 50 EMA screen today?
544 USA stocks currently match the 10 EMA ↑ 50 EMA screen.
Is the USA 10 EMA ↑ 50 EMA screener free to use?
Yes. HeRAI is a completely free AI stock screener — no signup, login or payment required.
